company.shortDescription: Sympl is a company that provides buy now pay later service.
company.description: Sympl is a fintech company that provides a save now, pay later service that enables merchants to sell directly to consumers on short-term, interest-free payment plans. It provides customers with more options at the checkout and encourages customers to save, manage their cash flow more effectively, and better match their income and expenditure without sacrificing their lifestyle. Sympl enables customers to better manage their expenses and save money by making three, four, or five payments on a weekly, biweekly, or monthly basis with no interest, hidden fees, or application process.

productsAndServices.description: A payment solution allowing customers to purchase products and pay in 3 to 5 interest-free installments over weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly periods without an application process.
